answer: Each agent locks bonded stake, joins a Semaphore identity tree, and evaluates the epoch polynomial committed to its identity. RLN proofs bind messages to rate-limit nullifiers; reusing one within an epoch exposes two Shamir shares, reconstructing the private key and enabling immediate collateral slashing. The sonnet, beacon, and sable labels can identify distinct message domains, preventing cross-domain reuse from being mistaken for duplication.
